summary: Ubuntu 19.10 (Eoan Ermine) was released on 17 October 2019. Features: GNOME 3.34, kernel 5.3, ZFS support as an experimental root option in the installer. The ermine (stoat in winter coat) suggested elegance and dawn ('eoan'). ZFS root was a notable experimental option for advanced users.
notes: Unsupported since 2020-07-17. Kernel 5.3. ZFS root install remained experimental; production use typically preferred ext4 or LVM.
